paper-001:
Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing for Low-Latency Inference

Abstract: We present a token-level routing scheme that reduces expert activation by 38% while preserving accuracy. Our approach uses a learned gating network with a load-balancing auxiliary loss. Experiments on public benchmarks show a 1.9x throughput improvement at equal quality. All data in this paper is synthetic and for demo purposes only.
paper-002:
Quantization-Aware Distillation of Long-Context Transformers

Abstract: A distillation recipe that retains 99.1% of teacher quality at 4-bit weights for context windows up to 256k tokens. We combine rotary scaling with a calibration-free quantization pass. This is synthetic demo content.
paper-003:
Retrieval-Augmented Agents for Scientific Literature Review

Abstract: An agentic pipeline that plans multi-hop searches and synthesizes cited summaries. We describe the planner, retriever, and verifier components. Synthetic demo content.
